name: Paper Territory
tagline: Draw a loop. Claim the map. Guard your trail.
description: Everyone races across one map. Leave your home to draw a trail, then return to your land to claim everything inside. Cut another player's trail to send them home. Most land after two minutes wins.
howToPlay: Tap an arrow to change direction. You keep moving; you cannot reverse.
Leave your land, draw a loop, then return to claim the inside. Your numbered home stays yours.
Touch an exposed trail to cut it. Walls, your own trail and head-on crashes send you home after three seconds.
Most land when the two-minute clock ends wins.
